thesis_data <- thesis_data %>%
  mutate(
    T_SRGSR_mean = rowMeans(select(., starts_with("T_SRGSR_")), na.rm = TRUE),
    I_SRGSR_mean = rowMeans(select(., starts_with("I_SRGSR_")), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

srgsr_cor <- corr.test(
  thesis_data %>% select(T_SRGSR_mean, I_SRGSR_mean),
  use = "pairwise.complete.obs",
  method = "pearson",
  adjust = "none",
  ci = TRUE
)

print(srgsr_cor, short = FALSE)

library(tibble)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

Attaching package: 'kableExtra'
The following object is masked from 'package:dplyr':

    group_rows
r_val <- round(srgsr_cor$r[1,2], 2)
ci_lower <- round(srgsr_cor$ci[1,1], 2)
ci_upper <- round(srgsr_cor$ci[1,2], 2)
p_val <- srgsr_cor$p[1,2]
p_str <- ifelse(p_val < .001, "< .001", paste0("= ", round(p_val, 3)))

apa_corr_table <- tibble(
  Variables = "Target & Informant PTG",
  `*r*` = r_val,
  `95% CI` = paste0("[", ci_lower, ", ", ci_upper, "]"),
  `*p*` = p_str
)

apa_corr_table %>%
  kable(
    format = "html",
    col.names = c("Variables", "r", "95% CI", "p"),
    align = c("l", "c", "c", "c"),
    caption = "<b>Table 1</b><br><em>Trait-Level Agreement on Posttraumatic Growth.</em>"
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "center",
    html_font = "Times New Roman"
  ) %>%

    column_spec(1:4, extra_css = "border-top: none; border-bottom: none;") %>%
  
  row_spec(0, extra_css = "border-bottom: 1px solid black;")

Looking good thus far! This was lowkey all I did for my main analysis (everything else got shifted to exploratory). Next portfolio will look at the exploratory analyses which were a bit more exciting, multiple moderator regression analyses. Stay tuned!
